title: Leverage
description:
S01 E04 — The Miracle Job
Nate helps his old friend Father Paul stop the demolition of his church. His means however, a fake miracle, are a lot less holy than his ends.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E11 — And the Graffiti of the Gods
Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl; the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:

General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E07 — And the Disenchanted Forest
When dissension threatens the group, Baird takes the Librarians to a charismatic self-help guru's team-building camp on the edge of a forest where people have been mysteriously disappearing.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E08 — And the Hidden Sanctuary
Cassandra decides to take a vacation after she freezes up during a mission; during her visit to Havenport, labeled the "Safest Town in America," Cassandra believes things may not be as ideal as they seem.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E09 — And a Town Called Feud
When a town's Civil War re-enactment is plagued by ghosts, the Librarians have to uncover the truth of what really happened there over 100 years ago.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E10 — And Some Dude Named Jeff
After switching bodies with a 28-year-old slacker named Jeff, Jenkins enlists the help of Jeff's hapless friends to find his way back into the Library to correct the mistake.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E11 — And the Trial of the One
It's time to choose the Librarian who will be tethered to Baird, but no one can decide, so the Library comes up with a trial during which the Librarians will be reduced to their most primal selves and abandoned in nightmarish landscapes.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E12 — And the Echoes of Memory
The world is morphed into an unrecognizable place where the library never existed; Baird brings the librarians together in an attempt to prevent the bleak, new world from becoming the new reality.

description:

description:

When a wealthy businessman asks the team to find his missing wife, they learn the missing woman is part of a ring of grifters running Sweetheart Scams, in which pretty young women woo and wed older men for their money.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E16 — The Gold Job
The team targets a corrupt pair of siblings and steers them through an elaborate treasure hunt.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E17 — The Radio Job
Latimer hires Nate's father to do a heist in a government office; the team must stage a hostage stand-off when they are trapped inside a building.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E18 — The Last Dam Job
The team is forced to recruit old friends and rivals in order to take down Latimer and an enemy from their past.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E01 — The (Very) Big Bird Job
A shipping CEO's cost-cutting measures result in a plane crash; the team cons a CEO into buying the Spruce Goose.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E02 — The Blue Line Job
The team tries to keep a hockey enforcer from sustaining permanent injury in the playoffs.

title: Leverage
description:

The team tries to convince a wealthy scientist, who stole from his former research partner, that he has made first contact with aliens.

title: Leverage
description:

The team attempts to bring down a restaurateur who destroys lives in his pursuit of fame and money.

description:

The team must tackle Congress in order to bring down a competitive cheerleading company that profits by putting teenage girls at risk.

title: Leverage
description:

When a dying FBI agent reveals his greatest failure, Nate becomes obsessed with solving the mystery.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E07 — The Real Fake Car Job
The team fakes the discovery of an antique car in order to convince a Wall Street fraud to break the deal that protects him from prosecution.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E08 — The Broken Wing Job
Parker is left behind on the crew's latest job because of her broken leg; Parker discovers a group of thieves are planning a heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E10 — The Frame-Up Job
Nate must use his investigating skills to clear Sophie's name when she is implicated in the theft of a valuable painting.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E09 — The Rundown Job
Col. Vance, Eliot, Hardison and Parker race to stop a terrorist from launching an attack on Washington.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E11 — The Low Low Price Job
The crew sabotages a mega-store in order to keep it from destroying a small town.

description:

The team must run a difficult con in order to prevent a businessman from destroying his company and the town it supports.

title: Leverage
description:

The team travels into Oregon wine country to steal a rare bottle of wine as part of their current con.

title: Leverage
description:

The team creates a global toy craze to take on a CEO who is about to release a dangerous toy onto the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E15 — The Long Good-bye Job
The team embarks on its riskiest con yet when Nate takes a case linked to his son's death.

description:

description:

description:

description:
